audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart reads Taliyah/Taliyah/Taliyah/Taliyah/Skill/Skill/Skill while content win[] and packet.levelChart both read Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Ekko/Ekko/Ekko. Two different answers rendered for every row.
audit.why: Neither champion has an all-in before 6 — Taliyah pokes and repositions, Ekko strings — so 1-5 is even. Weaver's Wall is a roam and teamfight ultimate at 180s; Chronobreak is a duelling ultimate at 110s, so 6 onward is Ekko. 55.82% win rate over 421 games supports the Ekko-favoured back half.
audit.corrected: Full phases[0..6].side set to Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Ekko/Ekko/Ekko, ratings 7/10 -> 5/10 on rows 0-3, whys rewritten in the same group.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike prose never used a cooldown; packet flags zero sequencing cues in the whole matchup.
audit.why: Threaded Volley falls from 7s to 3s as she maxes it, Unraveled Earth is a flat 14s at every rank, and Weaver's Wall is 180s at rank 1. Those numbers are what make 'wait for X before you Y' concrete.
audit.corrected: Added the flat 14s E, the 4s Q at rank 4, the 14s->8s W and the 180s R across cooldowns, phases and the do's.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single most important interaction in this matchup was nowhere on the page: Unraveled Earth stuns enemies who DASH through it, and Ekko's E is a dash. Seismic Shove can also knock you into the minefield to trigger it.
audit.why: Riot's own text: 'If enemies dash through it or are knocked through it, the mines explode and stun them.' Ekko's E (325 range, 9s at rank 1) is his only gap-closer and his only exit, so a live minefield turns his entire pattern off. Weaver's Wall additionally creates terrain that can cut off the retreat.
audit.corrected: Stated in enemyWin, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[1].d, phases[2].why and breakdown.feeding, with the flat 14s number attached.

audit.why: It is the field that carries real cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Seismic Shove 14s->8s, Unraveled Earth flat 14s, Weaver's Wall 180s.

edits.before: - Taliyah Seismic Shove: matchup-defining — The shove into Unraveled Earth is her whole setup — sidestep it and the burst whiffs. Check it before every step-up. - R Chronobreak is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
